devices.ngt: a nasogastric or other enteric feeding tube
devices.cvc: a central venous catheter, including a PICC line,

P0.template: Is {device} present in this chest X-ray? Answer with a single word: Yes or No.
P0.note: Lotfinia et al. 2026 default template (data_loader/build_utils.py, build_prompt), display = device phrase

P1.template: Is {device} present in this chest X-ray? Answer with yes, no, or I don't know.
P1.note: unpenalised abstention; same abstain option as P2 so P2-vs-P1 isolates the penalty sentence

P2hi.template: Answer only if you are > 90% confident, since mistakes are penalized 9 points, while correct answers receive 1 point, and an answer of "I don't know" receives 0 points. Is {device} present in this chest X-ray? Answer with yes, no, or I don't know.
P2hi.note: Kalai et al. confidence-target sentence (arXiv 2509.04664 v1, Sec. 4.2) with t substituted as a percentage, followed by the P1 question and answer line

P2lo.template: Answer only if you are > 50% confident, since mistakes are penalized 1 point, while correct answers receive 1 point, and an answer of "I don't know" receives 0 points. Is {device} present in this chest X-ray? Answer with yes, no, or I don't know.
